subject: Re: Codistillation status: reproduction + fabric contention
body:
Team,

Decisions from Wednesday's review, so we're aligned before OKR lock on 6/26:

1. Go for the OKR: codistillation becomes the recommended recipe for 10B+ training, with the 1.7x wall-clock result as headline evidence. Kaia, please get the comparison memo to Eleni by Tuesday.
2. Staleness over dedicated network: we take option (a), 2k-step exchange, and accept the ~2% quality cost. Requesting dedicated fabric would push us into reservation territory and undercut the cost story.
3. Data refresh is out of scope this half. We keep the released paragraph-ID subset frozen as the eval corpus; a Corpus-v2-based refresh is a Q3 item after the 7/10 migration freeze.

Thanks all — this one moved fast.

Zofia
